gaps.GET /v1/classifiers: lists the customer classifiers and every version with its lifecycle status (exact-data-match values shown as a count only)
gaps.POST /v1/classifiers: creates a classifier and drafts its first version (regex, keyword, dictionary or exact-data-match; EDM values hashed on the request, never stored)
gaps.POST /v1/classifiers/:id/versions: drafts the next version of a classifier
gaps.POST /v1/classifiers/:id/versions/:versi: submits a drafted version to a named reviewer in the approvals queue; it publishes only when approved
gaps.POST /v1/classifiers/:id/retire: retires a published classifier (removes a control: settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/classifiers/test: dry-runs an unsaved classifier definition against sample text and returns a match count (nothing stored)
